probable.zh: 如果 Caligula 去世了，这看起来极有可能，他就可以指出自己对皇帝是多么忠诚，为了他心爱的主人，他甚至愿意在竞技场中战斗并很可能牺牲。

probable.zh: 我们知道 Caligula 喜欢开玩笑，并且有着恶魔般的幽默感，似乎更有可能是他当时正计划这样做来羞辱他的元老院议员，或者他只是顺口说了一句类似“某某某太废物了，我的马都比他治理得好”这样的话。

proceed.en: For example, hand waving can mean 'please proceed' in one culture, but 'thank you' in another.

pressure.zh: 虽然冷战并不是从公开的战斗开始的，但它造成了持续的压力。

previously.zh: 最后，“使……常规化”（normalise）意味着在以前不正常或不可接受的时候，将其视为正常或可接受的。

prompt.en: I’m also going to be talking relatively generally, rather than going into specific prompts and exercises.
prompt.zh: 我也将进行比较概括的探讨，而不是深入探讨具体的提示词和练习。

prompt.en: It would just generate random IELTS style writing prompts every day, and I made it using Claude.
prompt.zh: 它每天只会生成随机的雅思风格写作提示，而我是用Claude制作的。

prompt.en: Vague prompts lead to vague results. When you ask someone a good question, you are clear about your intent.
prompt.zh: 模糊的提示词会导致模糊的结果。当你向某人提出一个好问题时，你的意图是很清晰的。

proportion.en: Unlike a large proportion of the young men he commanded, Fawcett survived the Somme.
proportion.zh: 与他麾下的大多数年轻人不同，Fawcett 在索姆河战役中活了下来。

proportion.en: Yes. I asked you, What proportion of wildfires are caused by people?
proportion.zh: 对。我问你的是，野火中有多大比例是人为造成的？

proportion.en: So, according to the Natural History Museum of Utah, what proportion of wildfires is caused by people?
proportion.zh: 那么，根据犹他州自然历史博物馆的数据，野火中有多大比例是由人为原因引起的？

proportion.en: Which reminds me of my question, Beth – what proportion of 11 to 30 year-olds get acne to some extent?
proportion.zh: 这让我想起了我的问题，Beth——11到30岁的人群中，有多少比例在某种程度上长痤疮？

proportion.en: This is one of the highest proportions anywhere in the world.
proportion.zh: 这是世界上比例最高的国家之一。

profession.en: Jargon means special words and phrases that are used in a particular profession or subject.
profession.zh: 行话是指在特定行业或学科中使用的专门词汇和短语。

profession.en: Operations were painful and brutal, and Darwin soon realized that the medical profession wasn’t for him.
profession.zh: 手术过程痛苦且残忍，Darwin很快意识到医学行业并不适合他。

profession.en: For example, young people, online communities or people in certain professions will have different slang words.
profession.zh: 例如，年轻人、网络社群或特定行业的人会有不同的俚语词汇。

profession.en: And he was also not able to join his father’s profession.
profession.zh: 而且他也无法继承他父亲的职业。

profession.en: It is, for many professions, still an almost mandatory requirement, making university a necessary next step after school.
profession.zh: 对许多职业来说，它仍然是一项几乎强制性的要求，使得上大学成为学校教育之后必要下一步。

provide.en: To give something a kick means to provide it with extra stimulation or excitement.
provide.zh: To give something a kick 意思是给某物带来额外的刺激或兴奋感。

provide.en: It was a business arrangement. Strongbow would provide soldiers and military skill.
provide.zh: 这是一场商业交易。Strongbow 提供士兵和军事技能。

provide.en: I guess what this means is that these territories provide France with economic opportunities and resources.
provide.zh: 我想这意味着这些领地为法国提供了经济机会和资源。

provide.en: They needed food that would provide them with enough energy to get through a difficult working day.
provide.zh: 他们需要能提供足够能量的食物，来度过艰难的工作日。

provide.en: The structured curriculum can provide the knowledge, communication opportunities, gives you a reason to use your knowledge.
provide.zh: 结构化的课程大纲可以提供知识，而交流机会则给了你使用知识的理由。

prevent.en: If something harmful is left unchecked, nobody controls it or prevents it from growing.
prevent.zh: 如果某种有害的东西被 left unchecked(放任不管)，就是说没有人控制它或阻止它继续扩大。

prevent.en: Apparently carbonated water was used to try to prevent scurvy on sea voyages.
prevent.zh: 显然，当时人们试图用碳酸水来预防海上航行的坏血病。

prevent.en: If something is left unchecked, nobody controls it or prevents it from increasing.
prevent.zh: 如果某样东西被 left unchecked(放任不管)，就是说没有人控制它或阻止它继续增长。

prevent.en: Tracking behavior in apps or on websites does not necessarily prevent harmful behavior in digital spaces.
prevent.zh: 在应用程序中或网站上追踪行为并不一定能防止数字空间中的有害行为。

prevent.en: OK. I like... Some scientists think zebras' distinctive black-and-white stripes prevent bites from flies and other insects.
prevent.zh: 好的。我喜欢……一些科学家认为，斑马独特的黑白条纹可以防止苍蝇和其他昆虫的叮咬。

preposition.en: The key difference between these three prepositions is how specific the time is.
preposition.zh: 这三个介词之间的核心区别在于时间有多具体。

preposition.en: The preposition via means by the way of or by the use of.
preposition.zh: 介词“通过”的意思是通过……的方式或通过使用……。

preposition.en: And throughout this episode I have been trying to demonstrate how to use English Prepositions of Time.
preposition.zh: 在整期节目中，我一直在试图演示如何使用英语时间介词。

preposition.en: Try describing surveillance in your city, on your street, and at your local bus stop using these prepositions naturally.
preposition.zh: 尝试使用这些介词自然地描述你所在的城市、街道以及当地公交车站的监控。

preposition.en: Prepositions of place show where something is.
preposition.zh: 表示地点的介词用来指明某物所在的位置。

production.en: And according to Alvaro, these elements of production are not believed to be beneficial.
production.zh: 根据 Alvaro 的说法，这些生产要素被认为是没有益处的。

production.en: One example of a kind of production that degrowthers disagree with is fast fashion.
production.zh: “减增长主义者”反对的一种生产方式就是快时尚。

production.en: In this episode, we'll be investigating the issues affecting food production in the UK.
production.zh: 在本期节目中，我们将调查影响英国粮食生产的问题。

production.en: Vancouver is a place of technology and film production and international trade with Asia.
production.zh: 温哥华则是科技、影视制作以及与亚洲开展国际贸易的重镇。

production.en: Britain became the pioneer of mass production, and this was applied to food as well.
production.zh: 英国成为了大规模生产的先驱，这也应用到了食品领域。

producer.en: I mentioned that Britain imports 40% of its food from other producers, mostly in Europe.
producer.zh: 我提到过英国 40% 的食物是从其他生产国进口的，其中大部分在欧洲。

producer.en: In economics, though, a cartel is just a group of independent producers, producers of something.
producer.zh: 然而，在经济学中，卡特尔只是一群独立的生产者，某种产品的生产者。

producer.en: In economics, though, a cartel is just a group of independent producers, producers of something.
producer.zh: 然而，在经济学中，卡特尔只是一群独立的生产者，某种产品的生产者。

producer.en: Suddenly, journalists and television producers needed someone to explain these communities to the rest of America.
producer.zh: 突然之间，记者和电视制作人需要有人来向其余的美国人解释这些社区。

producer.en: Nigeria is Africa’s most populous country, the country with the biggest population, and also one of Africa’s largest oil producers.
producer.zh: 尼日利亚是非洲人口最多的国家，人口规模最大的国家，也是非洲最大的产油国之一。

protein.en: Unlike carbs – that's carbohydrates – and fat, consumers don't see any downside to eating protein.
protein.zh: 与碳水化合物——也就是碳水——和脂肪不同，消费者认为吃蛋白质没有任何坏处。

protein.en: Their argument is that eating more animal protein, not cooking, explains the anatomical changes.
protein.zh: 他们的论点是，吃更多的动物蛋白质，而不是烹饪，解释了这些解剖结构的变化。

protein.en: What she sees are protein products in abundance – in other words, in large quantities.
protein.zh: 她看到的是大量的蛋白质产品——换句话说，数量极多。

protein.en: And in return, they provided the animals with a steady source of protein.
protein.zh: 作为回报，人类为这些动物提供了稳定的蛋白质来源。

protein.en: I have no problems with that… it's just another form of protein, as far as I'm concerned – it's what's the healthiest.
protein.zh: 我对此没有问题……在我看来，它只是另一种形式的蛋白质——什么最健康才是关键。

prescribe.en: A lot of people with diabetes also haveobesity and part of the effects of actually reversing the diabetes is the fact that they lose weight and so doctors began to sort of prescribe them off-label.
prescribe.zh: 许多糖尿病患者也患有肥胖症，而实际逆转糖尿病的部分效果就在于他们减轻了体重，因此医生开始有些“超说明书”地开这些药。

practically.en: For the next seventeen months, his family received practically no information about his condition.
practically.zh: 在接下来的17个月里，他的家人几乎得不到任何关于他状况的信息。

practically.en: The reality is that it was an absolute last resort for practically everyone.
practically.zh: 现实情况是，对几乎所有人来说，这是绝对的最后手段。

practically.en: There was practically no infrastructure, no way of getting from one castle to the next.
practically.zh: 那里几乎没有基础设施，没有从一座城堡到下一座城堡的交通方式。

practically.en: Tourism was practically dead, foreign investors had bolted, and bread lines were sparking riots.
practically.zh: 旅游业几乎瘫痪，外国投资者逃之夭夭，排队买面包引发了骚乱。

practically.en: In this episode, we’re going to break it down clearly and practically.
practically.zh: 在本期节目中，我们将进行清晰而实用的剖析。

prize.en: Marie Skłodowska Curie became the first woman ever to win a Nobel Prize.
prize.zh: Marie Skłodowska Curie 成为历史上第一位获得诺贝尔奖的女性。

prize.en: In 1911, Marie Skłodowska- Curie received her second Nobel Prize this time in Chemistry.
prize.zh: 1911 年，Marie Skłodowska-Curie 获得了她的第二个诺贝尔奖，这一次是化学奖。

prize.en: Prized for its taste and medicinal properties, in ancient times honey was known as 'liquid gold'.
prize.zh: 蜂蜜因其口感和药用价值而备受珍视，在古代被称为“液体黄金”。

prize.en: The top prizes for any professional chef are Michelin stars, awards given to restaurants offering outstanding cooking.
prize.zh: 对任何职业厨师来说，最高荣誉就是米其林星级，这是颁发给提供杰出烹饪的餐厅的奖项。

prize.en: It is often described as the Nobel Prize of computing, and recognizes individuals who have made lasting contributions to computer science.
prize.zh: 它常被誉为计算机界的诺贝尔奖，旨在表彰对计算机科学做出持久贡献的个人。

press.en: One of those who did respond was the White House Press Secretary, Karoline Leavitt.
press.zh: 白宫新闻秘书 Karoline Leavitt 就是回复的人之一。

press.en: Cuneiform symbols were pressed into soft clay tablets using a stylus, like a stick.
press.zh: 楔形文字符号是用触笔（类似于小棍子）压印在软泥板上的。

press.en: To grind food means to crush it into powder by being pressed between two hard surfaces.
press.zh: grind（研磨）食物意味着通过在两个坚硬表面之间挤压将其压碎成粉末。

press.en: Around the 1450s, Johannes Gutenberg developed the movable type printing press.
press.zh: 大约在1450年前后，约翰内斯·古腾堡发明了活字印刷机。

press.en: In Cuneiform, symbols are pressed into clay tablets with a stylus.
press.zh: 在楔形文字中，符号是用笔尖压印在泥板上的。

pronunciation.en: Polish and English are very different languages, so the pronunciations can be quite different.
pronunciation.zh: 波兰语和英语是截然不同的语言，所以发音可能会有很大差异。

pronunciation.en: Children seem to be better at learning things like pronunciation and those grammar aspects.
pronunciation.zh: 孩子们似乎更擅长学习发音和那些语法方面的东西。

pronunciation.en: Clear pronunciation is a skill that most people improve through listening and practicing sounds.
pronunciation.zh: 清晰的发音是一种技能，大多数人通过聆听和练习发音来提升它。

pronunciation.en: I don’t speak Italian, so if I make pronunciation mistakes, I am very sorry.
pronunciation.zh: 我不会说意大利语，所以如果我发音有误，我深表歉意。

pronunciation.en: And I’m also not using the American English pronunciations, but the British pronunciations.
pronunciation.zh: 而且我用的也不是美式英语发音，而是英式发音。

prospect.en: Now, clearly, the nuclear engineer most likely has better career prospects; they can get promoted, paid more, and perhaps the work is more fulfilling than in many minimum-wage jobs.
prospect.zh: 显然，核工程师很可能拥有更好的职业前景；他们可以获得晋升，拿到更高的薪水，而且工作可能比许多最低工资的工作更有成就感。

prospect.en: Everyone would be far better off if they pretended to fight a little, and they could return to their masters with a large invoice and the prospect of more work to come.
prospect.zh: 如果大家都假装打一会儿，然后带着一大笔账单和未来更多工作的希望回到各自的主子身边，那么对所有人来说都会好得多。

prospect.en: BBC World Service programme People Fixing the World met Kate at the report's London launch event, where she explained why being dyslexic can actually give advantages in life, including some exciting job prospects.
prospect.zh: BBC World Service 的节目 People Fixing the World 在该报告的伦敦发布会上采访了 Kate，她在会上解释了为什么患有读写障碍实际上能给生活带来优势，包括一些令人兴奋的就业前景。

prospect.en: If he feels like he will lose the election by a lower margin in July than he would in December, well this helps his future career prospects, it helps him in his life after being Prime Minister.
prospect.zh: 如果他觉得7月输掉选举的差距会比12月小，那么这有助于他未来的职业前景，有助于他卸任首相后的生活。

property.en: But there are also some global forces, factors that affect the global property market.
property.zh: 但也有一些全球性的力量，即影响全球房地产市场的因素。

property.en: They believed that property values would always rise, houses would always become more expensive.
property.zh: 他们坚信房地产价值永远会上涨，房子只会越来越贵。

property.en: Wealth in the terms of buying numerous properties or having a massive pension fund.
property.zh: 这里所说的财富是指购买多处房产或拥有庞大的养老金基金。

property.en: They have rights just for being human. These rights include life, liberty, and property.
property.zh: 他们仅仅因为是人类就拥有权利。这些权利包括生命、自由和财产。

property.en: He boarded a plane and flew to Togo, then to Morocco, where he had property.
property.zh: 他登上一架飞机飞往多哥，然后前往他拥有房产的摩洛哥。

profile.en: An unlikely profile for someone who would become the leader of the last great Gaelic resistance to English rule.
profile.zh: 对于一个即将成为最后一次伟大的盖尔人反抗英国统治领袖的人来说，这样的背景确实出人意料。

profile.en: It is not unique to people with unusual psychological profiles, or to people raised in particular ideological systems.
profile.zh: 它并非心理特征异常之人所独有，也不是在特定意识形态体系下成长起来的人才会有的东西。

profile.en: Now, one recent dating experiment looked into what people say they want in an ideal partner according to their dating profile.
profile.zh: 最近有一项约会实验调查了人们在约会资料中声称理想伴侣应具备的条件。

profile.en: The bomber had taken meticulous care to cover his tracks, all sorts of psychological profiles had proven to be fruitless, and despite spending today’s equivalent of more than $100 million on the investigation, they were no closer to finding him.
profile.zh: 炸弹客煞费苦心地抹去行踪，各种心理侧写都被证明是徒劳的，尽管花费了相当于今天超过 1 亿美元的调查资金，他们离找到他依然毫无进展。

preference.en: Someone's personal preference is their subjective liking or disliking for something, based on their own opinion.
preference.zh: 个人的偏好（personal preference）是某人基于自己的观点对某事的主观喜爱或厌恶。

preference.en: Why are our preferences at 45 often different from those at 25?
preference.zh: 为什么我们在45岁时的偏好常常与25岁时不同？

preference.en: Oh yeah, that's great! Exactly! Jolene says the popularity of different snacks depends on personal preference – someone's subjective liking or disliking for something, based on their personal opinion.
preference.zh: 噢是的，那太棒了！没错！Jolene 说，不同零食的受欢迎程度取决于个人偏好（personal preference）——即某人基于个人观点对某事的主观喜爱或厌恶。

preference.en: In other words, there was a strong preference for the idea that citizenship is something that is passed down from generation to generation, not easily acquired by cultural assimilation.
preference.zh: 换句话说，它强烈倾向于这样一种观点：公民身份是代代相传的东西，而不是通过文化同化轻易获得的。

private.en: We accept it, that’s fine. But surveillance is now common in private spaces too.
private.zh: 我们接受它，这很好。但监控现在在私人空间里也很常见。

private.en: Is a private one-to-one class better than a small group or a large class?
private.zh: 一对一的私教课比小班课或大班课更好吗？

private.en: However, it’s unusual for governments to intervene - to become involved - in people’s private lives this way.
private.zh: 然而，政府以这种方式干预——介入——人们的私生活是不寻常的。

private.en: For example, you could go onto italki or Preply and choose a private English teacher.
private.zh: 例如，你可以上italki或Preply选择一个私人英语老师。

private.en: People were also uncomfortable with the fact that the New7Wonders Foundation was a private organization.
private.zh: 人们也对新七大奇迹基金会是一个私人组织感到不安。

prefer.en: Barbara wants her son to eat healthy, homemade food, although he prefers modern, packaged snacks.
prefer.zh: Barbara 希望她的儿子吃健康的自制食物，尽管他更喜欢现代包装零食。

prefer.en: Humans naturally prefer simple explanation and ideas that agree with what we already believe.
prefer.zh: 人类天生更喜欢简单的解释以及符合我们既有信念的观点。

prefer.en: They prefer the result. They will even delay gratification to get it.
prefer.zh: 它们喜欢这个结果。它们甚至愿意为了得到它而延迟满足。

prefer.en: He preferred logic and problem solving to small talk and social rules.
prefer.zh: 相比于闲聊和社交规则，他更偏爱逻辑与解决问题。

prefer.en: Saudi Arabia prefers higher oil prices. They support limiting the oil supply.
prefer.zh: 沙特阿拉伯更喜欢较高的油价。他们支持限制石油供应。

protective.en: In… what I meant when I said that it's protective is that kids build resiliency, confidence, coping strategies, regulation strategies.
protective.zh: 在……我刚才说它有保护作用的意思是，孩子们建立起了韧性、自信、应对策略、调节策略。

protective.en: This company was chosen to provide protective equipment, PPE, and received two government contracts from the Conservative government worth about £203 million pounds.
protective.zh: 这家公司被选中提供防护装备（PPE），并从保守党政府获得了两份价值约2.03亿英镑的政府合同。

praise.en: To give a shout-out to someone means to praise them in public.
praise.zh: give a shout-out to someone 意思是公开赞扬某人。

praise.en: And everywhere garlic grew, it was praised for its health-giving powers.
praise.zh: 而且无论大蒜生长在哪里，它都因其保健功效而备受赞誉。

praise.en: To give a shout-out to someone means topublicly praise them.
praise.zh: give a shout-out to someone 意思是公开赞扬某人。

praise.en: The country most often praised by economists is Norway.
praise.zh: 最常受到经济学家称赞的国家是挪威。

praise.en: And it was also praised by some foreign commentators.
praise.zh: 它也受到了一些外国评论员的赞扬。

propose.en: And degrowth underestimates the social, sort of, feasibility of what they propose.
propose.zh: “减增长”还低估了他们所提议内容的社会可行性。

propose.en: He could propose similar things in other cities, maybe encourage it nationwide.
propose.zh: 他可能会在其他城市提出类似的想法，也许会在全国范围内推广。

propose.en: The commission has three main roles. Propose new laws, enforce EU rules, and manage the EU’s budget.
propose.zh: 该委员会有三大主要职责：提出新法律、执行欧盟规则以及管理欧盟预算。

propose.en: To do this, he has proposed creating a permanent government office in Manchester, nicknamed the Number Ten North.
propose.zh: 为了做到这一点，他提议在曼彻斯特设立一个常设政府办公室，被称为“北方十号”。

propose.en: A hypothesis is a suggestion that's proposed to explain something, which can then be tested to see if it's true.
propose.zh: 假说是为了解释某事而提出的建议，然后可以通过测试来检验它是否真实。

preserve.en: And, above all, it preserved consensus among a very large pool of powerful princes.
preserve.zh: 最重要的是，它在数量庞大的强大王子群体中保持了共识。

preserve.en: Through writing, Egypt preserved stories about Gods and Pharaohs and also people’s everyday life.
preserve.zh: 通过文字，埃及保存了关于神灵、法老以及人们日常生活的故事。

preserve.en: Writing allowed people to record laws, preserve stories, collect knowledge, and communicate across generations.
preserve.zh: 文字让人类能够记录法律、保存故事、积累知识并跨越代际进行交流。

preserve.en: The fact that the Spanish never discovered it helped preserve much of the site.
preserve.zh: 西班牙人从未发现它的事实帮助保护了这处遗址的大部分。

preserve.en: Peasants across Europe ate simple food based on what they could grow, raise, preserve, catch.
preserve.zh: 整个欧洲的农民都吃简单的食物，这取决于他们能种植、饲养、保存或捕获什么。

progress.en: Having a balance between the two gives you a more complete sense of progress.
progress.zh: 在两者之间保持平衡能让你对进步有更完整的感知。

primate.zh: 下一集，我们将走进 Harry Harlow 猴子实验那个令人不安的世界，“爱究竟是什么”这个问题，在威斯康星州的一间灵长类实验室里接受了检验。

pregnant.en: And they were women: pregnant women, unmarried mothers, widows, or women whose husbands had abandoned them.
pregnant.zh: 他们是女性：孕妇、未婚母亲、寡妇，或是被丈夫抛弃的妇女。

pregnant.zh: 今天，一个怀孕的单亲妈妈、一个孤儿或一个年纪太大而无法工作的男子，再也不用被迫按响济贫院大门外的铃铛；现在有了各种系统和保障措施，以确保每个人在理论上都享有过上有尊严生活的权利。

productive.en: But by this period, in many workhouses, it served no productive purpose at all.

productive.zh: 你的语言技能越弱，你对经济的平均产出效率就越低。

productive.en: Although Ramanujan’s years in the UK were incredibly productive, they also took a serious toll on his health.
productive.zh: 尽管Ramanujan在英国的几年多产得惊人，但这对其健康造成了严重的损害。

productive.en: But they can be incredibly helpful, saving you time, making you more productive, and assisting you in a myriad of ways.
productive.zh: 但它们可以带来难以置信的帮助，为你节省时间、提高工作效率，并以无数种方式协助你。

productive.en: The biggest benefit to having a positive mindset, a growth mindset, is that it can help you respond to difficulty in a productive way.
productive.zh: 拥有积极思维、成长型思维的最大好处在于，它能以富有成效的方式帮你应对困难。

prison.en: The guards had been given a very simple instruction: maintain order in the prison.
prison.zh: 狱警们得到的指示非常简单：维持监狱秩序。

prince.en: Rival princes who had not been caught up in the Ritz-Carlton purge suddenly found themselves silenced.
prince.zh: 那些没有在丽思卡尔顿大清洗中落网的敌对亲王们突然发现自己被噤声了。

prince.en: Theseus was a prince of Athens, but as a child he didn’t know he was royalty.
prince.zh: 忒修斯是雅典的王子，但小时候他并不知道自己是皇室成员。

prince.zh: 他的长子、未来的 George IV 被任命为摄政王代行统治。

princess.zh: 忒修斯遇到了一位公主，米诺斯国王的女儿。

princess.en: And then, in 1810, following the death of his youngest daughter, Princess Amelia, he began to decline for the final time.
princess.zh: 然后，在 1810 年，在他最小的女儿阿米莉亚公主去世后，他的健康状况开始最后一次恶化。

princess.en: There is no public list, but it’s estimated that there are anywhere between 5,000 and 15,000 princes and princesses in Saudi Arabia.

preside.en: And the second is to preside over the Senate and cast a tie-breaking vote when needed.

preside.en: He was a quiet man who wanted to grow turnips and read about astronomy, and there he was, presiding over one of the most violent and consequential periods in modern history.

prisoner.en: Half were randomly assigned to be guards, and half were assigned to be prisoners.
prisoner.zh: 一半人被随机分配当狱警，另一半被分配当囚犯。

prisoner.zh: 现实中的狱警和囚犯，来自截然不同的背景，也有着截然不同的动机。

prisoner.en: He delighted in seeing people squirm. Prisoners were executed in front of him for sport.
prisoner.zh: 他以看着别人痛苦挣扎为乐。囚犯们为了供他消遣而在他面前被处决。

prisoner.en: Gladiators fought to the death, and prisoners were executed in public.
prisoner.zh: 角斗士为荣誉和生命而战，罪犯则被公开处决。

prisoner.en: The Roman line collapsed. Thousands were killed or taken prisoner.
prisoner.zh: 罗马防线崩溃了。数千人战死或被俘。

precise.en: This is the story of space mining, or asteroid mining to be precise.
precise.zh: 这就是太空采矿的故事，准确地说是小行星采矿的故事。

precise.en: To be precise, this asteroid is thought to contain precious metals worth 10 quintillion dollars.
precise.zh: 准确地说，这颗小行星据信包含价值高达 10 京（10 quintillion）美元的贵金属。

precise.en: As you will know, there have been several presidents who have died in office, 8 to be precise.
precise.zh: 正如你所知，曾有几位总统在任内去世，确切地说是8位。

precise.zh: 她开发了高度精确的仪器来检测和测量辐射水平。

primarily.en: Most other provinces are primarily English-speaking, although there might be French-speaking communities.

primarily.en: Italy, by contrast, has held on tightly to the idea that citizenship is primarily something passed down through blood.

primarily.en: Earlier art in Europe tended to be primarily religious, looking at scenes from the Bible or painting religious figures.

prosperous.en: From the outside, the capital looked modern and prosperous, but inequality and poverty grew worse.
prosperous.zh: 从表面上看，首都显得现代而繁荣，但财富不均和贫困却在恶化。

prosperous.en: There are several countries that are both resource-rich and highly prosperous.
prosperous.zh: 有几个国家既资源丰富又高度繁荣。

prosperous.en: But over time, Virginia became prosperous.
prosperous.zh: 但随着时间推移，弗吉尼亚变得繁荣起来。

prosperous.en: One reporter describes him as looking less like a mercenary warlord than a prosperous farmer who just so happens to own a great deal of land.
prosperous.zh: 一位记者形容他看起来不像个雇佣兵军阀，倒更像个恰好拥有大量土地的富裕农场主。

prosperous.en: In the southeast of the country, the most prosperous region of England, the life expectancy at birth is 80.1, whereas in the northeast, where it is lowest, it is 77.2.
prosperous.zh: 在英格兰最繁华的东南部地区，出生时的预期寿命为80.1岁，而在寿命最短的东北部地区，仅为77.2岁。

prime.en: He’s a very lawyer-like prime minister. Burnham is seen as warmer and more emotional.
prime.zh: 他是一位非常具有律师风格的首相。而Burnham则被认为更温暖、更有情绪感染力。

prime.en: Number 10 Downing Street is the traditional home of the prime ministers in Central London.
prime.zh: 唐宁街10号是伦敦市中心首相的传统住所。

prime.en: The PAP won the 1959 election, and Lee Kuan Yew became Singapore’s first prime minister.
prime.zh: 人民行动党赢得了1959年的选举，李光耀成为新加坡第一任总理。

prime.en: Then, in the late 1970s, Britain got a new Prime Minister: Margaret Thatcher.
prime.zh: 随后在20世纪70年代末，英国迎来了一位新首相：Margaret Thatcher。

prime.en: Alternatively, a Prime Minister can lose support in the House of Commons itself.
prime.zh: 或者，首相可能会失去下议院本身的支持。

prophecy.en: He even, according to one report, brings a black dog with him, ensuring that the witchdoctor 's prophecy will come true.
prophecy.zh: 据一份报告称，他甚至还随身带了一条黑狗，确保巫医的预言应验。

prophecy.en: Now, were I the sort of person who believed in prophecies from witchdoctors, I think I'd probably focus on the man rather than the dog part.
prophecy.zh: 要是我这种会相信巫医预言的人，我觉得我大概会把注意力放在“人”身上，而不是“狗”身上。

pride.en: In fact, Australians take a lot of pride in their identity, in being Australian.
pride.zh: 事实上，澳大利亚人为自己的身份、为身为澳大利亚人感到十分骄傲。

pride.en: Caesar, a man who prided himself on his organisational ability, decided this couldn’t continue.
pride.zh: 恺撒是一个以自己的组织能力为傲的人，他决定不能任由这种情况继续下去。

pride.en: Will Putin’s legacy be that of a man who restored Russia’s pride and power?
pride.zh: 普京留下的政治遗产，会是一个恢复了俄罗斯尊严和力量的人吗？

pride.en: He positioned himself as the man who had restored Russia’s pride and power.
pride.zh: 把自己定位为恢复俄罗斯尊严和力量的人。

pride.en: But others were more sceptical. They said it was less about pride and more about power.
pride.zh: 但另一些人则更为怀疑。他们认为这与其说是关于自豪感，不如说是关于权力。

profitable.en: Oil is much more profitable. But what happens if the oil price suddenly falls?
profitable.zh: 石油的利润要高得多。但是，如果油价突然下跌会发生什么？

profitable.en: Because oil has been so profitable, other industries, especially manufacturing, have received less investment.
profitable.zh: 因为石油利润丰厚，其他行业（尤其是制造业）获得的投资较少。

profitable.en: Corruption is quite profitable. Being corrupt can make you a lot of money.
profitable.zh: 腐败的利润非常丰厚。腐败可以让你赚到大钱。

profitable.en: They became profitable and eventually dominated the digital economy.
profitable.zh: 它们开始盈利，并最终主导了数字经济。

province.en: Leinster is the eastern province of Ireland, the area that includes what is now Dublin.
province.zh: 伦斯特是爱尔兰东部的省份，包括现在的都柏林地区。

province.en: I guess it’s a bit like a state or a prefecture or a province.
province.zh: 我想这有点类似于美国的州、日本的县或者中国的省。

province.zh: 其他大多数省份主要说英语，尽管可能也存在一些法语社群。

province.zh: 新不伦瑞克省是加拿大唯一的官方双语省份，英语和法语在那里享有同等的法律地位。

previous.en: He would become fascinated by a new idea, move on, and not complete his previous work.
previous.zh: 他会对一个新想法着迷，然后转移注意力，不再完成之前的工作。

previous.en: You’ll know this if you’ve listened to my previous episodes on the history of various cities.
previous.zh: 如果你听过我先前关于各大城市历史的节目，你就会知道这一点。

previous.en: You probably can guess this from my previous section, clearing up the institutions and the common misconceptions.
previous.zh: 你大概从我之前理顺各大机构和常见误区的那一部分就能猜到这一点。

previous.en: Previous and subsequent emperors became deified after death, but Caligula demanded worship in his own lifetime.
previous.zh: 前任和后来的皇帝都是在死后才被奉为神明，但 Caligula 要求在世时就受到崇拜。

previous.en: You can find out more about why I moved to Japan in some previous Thinking in English episodes.
previous.zh: 你可以在之前的一些《Thinking in English》节目中了解更多关于我为什么搬到日本的原因。

priest.zh: 爱尔兰人保留了他们的神父、弥撒以及对罗马的忠诚。

priest.en: They also had a complex social hierarchy that organized society into nobles, warriors, priests, and farmers.
priest.zh: 他们还拥有复杂的社会等级制度，将社会组织为贵族、武士、祭司和农民。

priest.en: He had temples erected to his own glory, with priests appointed to offer sacrifices to him as though he were Jupiter.
priest.zh: 他为自己的荣耀建造了神庙，并指定祭司向他献祭，仿佛他就是 Jupiter。

priest.en: And most graduates would become clergyman, priests, or some form of administrator within the church or a city state system.
priest.zh: 大多数毕业生会成为神职人员、牧师，或者教会或城邦系统中的某种行政人员。

proposal.en: The proposal is specifically about this middle tier of offences, for now at least.
proposal.zh: 这项提案针对的，至少目前来说，是这类处于中间层级的罪行。

proposal.en: And it's worth being clear about what this proposal does not include.
proposal.zh: 值得说清楚的是，这项提案并不涉及哪些内容。

proposal.en: Another proposal is to limit the veto power, especially in situations involving genocide or other serious human rights violations.
proposal.zh: 另一个提案是限制否决权，特别是在涉及种族灭绝或其他严重侵犯人权行为的情况下。

proposal.en: While some of the proposals in this white paper are still being discussed, even as I’m recording this episode, they might have changed since it’s been recorded, others have already been implemented and more changes are scheduled to come into force soon.
proposal.zh: 虽然白皮书中的一些提案仍在讨论中——甚至在我录制这期节目时也是如此，而且自我录制以来它们可能已经发生了变化——但其他一些提案已经付诸实施，还有更多变更计划于近期生效。

proposal.en: Of those who voted, around 65% voted to reduce the term limit, with 35% voting against it, but this was to be expected; the Prime Minister, Giorgia Meloni, who was one of the major critics of the proposal, encouraged her supporters to boycott the referendum, so it was hardly surprising that more “yes” supporters turned up to vote than the “no” side.
proposal.zh: 在投票的人中，大约65%的人投票赞成缩短年限，35%的人投票反对，但这也在意料之中；强烈批评该提案的主要推手之一、总理 Giorgia Meloni 鼓励她的支持者抵制这场公投，因此支持“赞成”票的人数多于“反对”阵营也就不足为奇了。

preach.en: He had not published a pamphlet, or preached in a public square, or nailed anything to a church door.
preach.zh: 他没有发表小册子，没有在公共广场上演讲，也没有把任何东西钉在教堂大门上。

preach.en: Every Sunday, Reverend Samuel Parris, the village minister, would stand in front of his congregation and preach exactly this.
preach.zh: 每个星期天，村里的牧师塞缪尔·帕里斯（Samuel Parris）都会站在会众面前，宣讲的正是这些内容。

primitive.en: I probably pronounced that wrong. These peoples, these indigenous peoples, were not primitive societies, isolated societies.
primitive.zh: 我这个发音可能不太标准。这些人，这些原住民，并不是原始社会或孤立的社会。

primitive.en: Now, it is tempting to think of this as a story from the distant past — the kind of thing that happened in a more primitive era, before science and reason arrived to improve the world.

printer.en: Instead of carving entire pages into wood, printers could arrange individual metal letters and then reuse them repeatedly for different pages.

printer.zh: Carlile 是一名印刷商兼政治记者，在 19 世纪 20 年代，他因出版被认为具有亵渎性的著作而在狱中度过了多年，其中包括 Thomas Paine 的《理性时代》，该书对圣经和有组织宗教进行了批判。

proportional.en: To reiterate how this is different from a proportional voting system, in a proportional voting system, if a party gets, let’s say, 30% of the vote, they will have 30% of the representatives.
proportional.zh: 再次强调这与比例代表制有何不同：在比例代表制中，如果一个政党获得30%的选票，他们将拥有30%的代表席位。

proficiency.en: But do proficiency tests actually help you in your goal to become fluent in English?
proficiency.zh: 但英语熟练度测试真的能帮你实现流利说英语的目标吗？

proficiency.en: These things are definitely related. Proficiency and confidence are related, but they’re not the same thing.
proficiency.zh: 这些事情绝对是相关的。熟练度和自信相关，但它们不是一回事。

proficiency.en: It’s not the only country considering increasing language proficiency for visa holders.
proficiency.zh: 它也不是唯一一个考虑提高签证持有者语言熟练度的国家。

proficiency.en: I wanted to make progress. The third thing I am proud of is passing proficiency tests.
proficiency.zh: 我想取得进步。我感到骄傲的第三件事是通过了能力测试。

proficiency.en: But I’m not that technically skilled. I haven’t passed the highest level of the Japanese proficiency test.
proficiency.zh: 但我的技术并不那么熟练。我没有通过日语能力测试的最高级别。

proficient.en: I think sometimes people mistake a confident English speaker for someone who is highly proficient.
proficient.zh: 我觉得有时人们会把自信的英语说者误认为精通英语的人。

proficient.en: But this doesn’t mean that adults are incapable of becoming highly proficient.
proficient.zh: 但这并不意味着成年人就无法变得高度精通。

proficient.en: Proficient means skilled or capable at doing something.
proficient.zh: “精通”指的是在某事上熟练或能干。

proficient.en: If you are proficient in the language of the country you want to move to and you have skills or abilities that the country needs or wants, then you have an amazing chance at moving.
proficient.zh: 如果你精通你想移居的国家的语言，并且拥有该国需要或想要的技能或能力，那么你就有绝佳的机会移居。

presentation.en: A goal like giving a presentation or writing a report or passing an exam.
presentation.zh: 比如做演讲、写报告或通过考试这样的目标。

presentation.en: A confident public speaker still feels anxious before giving a presentation.
presentation.zh: 一个自信的公众演讲者在做演讲前依然会感到焦虑。

presentation.en: I have entered speech contests, I have given presentations, I have talked in front of people, and it is really fulfilling.
presentation.zh: 我参加过演讲比赛，做过展示，在众人面前发表过讲话，这真的很有成就感。

prose.en: A novel is a long fictional prose narrative with developed characters and a complex story.
prose.zh: 小说是一部具有成熟人物和复杂情节的长篇虚构散文叙事。

prose.en: A lot of early writing was not in prose, but it was written as poetry.
prose.zh: 许多早期的写作不是散文，而是以诗歌形式写成的。

prevention.en: One benefit is crime prevention on the street.
prevention.zh: 一个好处是街头犯罪预防。

prevention.en: But if we see poverty as a shared social challenge, a consequence of our society, well then solutions tend to appear in opportunity or support or prevention.​
prevention.zh: 但如果我们把贫困看作一个共同的社会挑战、一个我们社会带来的后果，那么解决方案往往就会在机会、支持或预防中显现。

prevention.en: Most people accept this kind of surveillance because it is linked to safety and theft prevention, but it still means we are being watched in a private business that we visit regularly.
prevention.zh: 大多数人接受这种监控，因为它与安全和防盗有关，但这仍然意味着我们在我们经常光顾的私人企业里被监视着。

probe.en: Probing questions help you go deeper. They’re often used when something isn’t clear or when you want more detail.
probe.zh: 追问能帮你进行更深入的探讨。当某事不够清晰或者当你想要更多细节时，它们经常被派上用场。
